```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggmosaic)
```


```{r}
key <- read.csv("../data/derived/timepoint_key.csv")
key.long <- read_csv("../data/derived/timepoint_key_long.csv")
taxa <- read.csv("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/bewell_taxonomy_relAbun.csv")
ipaq <- read.csv("../data/derived/09-10-21_demographics.csv")
met <- read_excel("../data/raw/urine-metabolomics/Dan Urine Anthocyanin 11-10-2022.xlsx", sheet = "concentration ng mL") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`21-V2`))
```

## try metbolomics 
```{r}
met <- met %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:81, 
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .x))
  ) %>%
  rename("metabolite" = `...1`) %>%
  separate(Sample, c("Subject.Number", "v")) %>%
  mutate(v = toupper(v))

# prep key
key.long <- key.long %>%
  mutate(v =  toupper(substr(timepoints, 11, 12)),
         v = ifelse(v == "-V", toupper(substr(timepoints, 12, 13)), v),
         Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number)) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, v, Timepoint) 

# join to met 
met <- met %>%
  left_join(key.long) %>%
  # filter to metabolites of interest
  filter(metabolite == "cy rut",
         Timepoint == "tB",
         value <= 0)
  # filter(metabolite %in% c("cy hex", "cy rut", "cy sam", "cy xyrut", "peon gluA", "peon hex", "peon rut", "peon sam", "peon xyrut")) %>%
```

keep only subjects that have both pre and post BRB
```{r}
key <- key %>%
  filter(!is.na(rB),
         !is.na(tB))
```

ipaq histogram
```{r}
ipaq <- ipaq %>% 
  # filter to only those who have multiple samples 
  filter(subject_number %in% key$Subject.Number,
  # filter out pt with low adherence 
         !subject_number %in% met$Subject.Number,
  # filter to those with IPAQ score
         !is.na(IPAQscore)) %>%
  mutate(metsTotal = METwalking + METmoderate + METvig + METmins,
         mets_simple = ifelse(metsTotal >= 5000, "active", "inactive"),
         ipaq_simple = ifelse((IPAQscore == "Minimally active" | IPAQscore == "HEPA active"), "active", "inactive"),
         ipaq_alt = ifelse(IPAQscore == "HEPA active" | metsTotal >= 5000, "active", "inactive"))
```

```{r}
key <- key %>%
  filter(Subject.Number %in% ipaq$subject_number,
         !Subject.Number %in% met$Subject.Number)
```

change in Blautia
```{r}
blaut_taxa <- taxa %>% 
  dplyr::filter(substr(Taxonomy, nchar(Taxonomy)-9 ,nchar(Taxonomy)) == "g__Blautia")

blaut_rB <- dplyr::filter(blaut_taxa, variable == "rB")
blaut_tB <- dplyr::filter(blaut_taxa, variable == "tB")
blaut_rP <- dplyr::filter(blaut_taxa, variable == "rP")
blaut_tP <- dplyr::filter(blaut_taxa, variable == "tP")
  
blaut <- 
  key %>%
  mutate(rB = ifelse(key$rB %in% blaut_rB$id, blaut_rB$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$rB), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tB = ifelse(key$tB %in% blaut_tB$id, blaut_tB$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$tB), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(rP = ifelse(key$rP %in% blaut_rP$id, blaut_rP$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$rP), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tP = ifelse(key$tP %in% blaut_tP$id, blaut_tP$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$tP), NA, 0))) %>%
  select(-placebo)
```

change in Lachnospiraceae
```{r}
lach_taxa <- taxa %>%
  dplyr::filter(substr(Taxonomy, nchar(Taxonomy)-17 ,nchar(Taxonomy)) == "f__Lachnospiraceae")

lach_rB <- dplyr::filter(lach_taxa, variable == "rB")
lach_tB <- dplyr::filter(lach_taxa, variable == "tB")
lach_rP <- dplyr::filter(lach_taxa, variable == "rP")
lach_tP <- dplyr::filter(lach_taxa, variable == "tP")
  
lach <- 
  key %>%
  mutate(rB = ifelse(key$rB %in% lach_rB$id, lach_rB$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$rB), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tB = ifelse(key$tB %in% lach_tB$id, lach_tB$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$tB), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(rP = ifelse(key$rP %in% lach_rP$id, lach_rP$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$rP), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tP = ifelse(key$tP %in% lach_tP$id, lach_tP$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$tP), NA, 0))) %>%
  select(-placebo)
```

change in Roseburia 
```{r}
rose_taxa <- taxa %>%
  dplyr::filter(substr(Taxonomy, nchar(Taxonomy)-11 ,nchar(Taxonomy)) == "g__Roseburia")

rose_rB <- dplyr::filter(rose_taxa, variable == "rB")
rose_tB <- dplyr::filter(rose_taxa, variable == "tB")
rose_rP <- dplyr::filter(rose_taxa, variable == "rP")
rose_tP <- dplyr::filter(rose_taxa, variable == "tP")
  
rose <- 
  key %>%
  mutate(rB = ifelse(key$rB %in% rose_rB$id, rose_rB$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$rB), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tB = ifelse(key$tB %in% rose_tB$id, rose_tB$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$tB), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(rP = ifelse(key$rP %in% rose_rP$id, rose_rP$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$rP), NA, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tP = ifelse(key$tP %in% rose_tP$id, rose_tP$RelAbun, ifelse(is.na(key$tP), NA, 0))) %>%
  select(-placebo)
```

mic hists
```{r}
blaut %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs(tB - rB))) +
  geom_histogram() + 
  xlab("Blautia") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept =  5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red3")

lach %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs(tB - rB))) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  xlab("Lachnospiraceae") +
  geom_vline(xintercept =  9, linetype = "dashed", color = "red3")

rose %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs(tB - rB))) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  xlab("Roseburia") +
  geom_vline(xintercept =  3, linetype = "dashed", color = "red3")
```

```{r}
ipaq <- ipaq %>%
  rename("Subject.Number" = subject_number,
         "Activity" = ipaq_alt)
```


```{r}
blaut <- blaut %>%
  mutate(dif = abs(tB - rB),
         Blautia = ifelse(dif >= 5, "BRB effective", "BRB not effective")) %>%
  left_join(ipaq)
  
lach <- lach %>%
  mutate(dif = abs(tB - rB),
         Lachnospiraceae = ifelse(dif >= 9, "BRB effective", "BRB not effective")) %>%
  left_join(ipaq) 

rose <- rose %>%
  mutate(dif = abs(tB - rB),
         Roseburia = ifelse(dif >= 3, "BRB effective", "BRB not effective")) %>%
  left_join(ipaq) 
```

```{r}
rose %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=metsTotal, y = dif)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm')
```


```{r}
blaut <- blaut %>% select(Activity, Blautia)
table(blaut)
lach <- lach %>% select(Activity, Lachnospiraceae)
table(lach)
rose <- rose %>% select(Activity, Roseburia)
table(rose)

# mosaicplot(table(blaut),
#   main = "Mosaic plot",
#   color = TRUE
# )

mosaicplot(table(lach),
  main = "Mosaic plot",
  color = TRUE
)

# mosaicplot(table(rose),
#   main = "Mosaic plot",
#   color = TRUE,
# )

# glammed up mosaic plot
lach$Activity <- factor(lach$Activity, levels = c("active", "inactive"))
lach$Lachnospiraceae <- factor(lach$Lachnospiraceae, levels = c("BRB not effective", "BRB effective"))

lach %>%
  mutate(Activity = ifelse(Activity == "active", "Active", "Inactive")) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_mosaic(aes(x = product(Activity, Lachnospiraceae), fill = Activity, alpha = Lachnospiraceae), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("cornflowerblue", "olivedrab4")) + 
  scale_alpha_manual(values =c(.7,.9)) +
  xlab("Lachnospiraceae enriched") +
  ylab("IPAQ Score") +
  theme(base_size = 9, legend.position = "none") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/ACSgrant_mosaicplot.png", dev = "png", height = 4, width = 5, dpi=400)

lach %>%
  mutate(Activity = ifelse(Activity == "active", "Active", "Inactive")) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_mosaic(aes(x = product(Activity, Lachnospiraceae), fill = Activity, alpha = Lachnospiraceae), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_mosaic_text(aes(x = product(Activity, Lachnospiraceae))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("cornflowerblue", "olivedrab4")) + 
  scale_alpha_manual(values =c(.7,.9)) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  theme(base_size = 9, legend.position = "none") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/ACSgrant_mosaicplot2.png", dev = "png", height = 4, width = 5, dpi=400)
```
